Overview

Kozhikode is a city in Kerala with a population of 2,000,000. A historic Malabar Coast city where Vasco da Gama first landed, known for its beaches, delicious cuisine, and spice trade heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
